text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm seeing a weird spike in invoice-preview deltas for a handful of tenants after yesterday's route-fallback canary. Small sample but +2-6% token delta vs production preview. anyone else?
jia: saw it too, poking logs now. looks correlated with requests that got retried by edge before reaching the router.
sam: retry + fallback chain could produce duplicate billing events if dedupe key is based only on request-id (which the retry resets).
rita: yeah our current dedupe uses `request_id` only. when edge retries with new id and we attach `orig_request_id` later, the metering ingester doesn't have orig id for a bit.
alex: timeline — edge retry -> new request_id -> router falls back to alternate model region -> router adds `route_origin` tag -> metering sidecar emits event with new id + route_origin. downstream dedupe happens later based on request_id so orig token usage is counted twice in preview.
billing-bot: flagged invoices: tenant_482, tenant_77, tenant_190. preview_delta: [2.1%, 3.8%, 5.6%].
jia: quick log snippet for one dup sample:
```
edge: recv req id=abc123, auth fail -> retry id=abc123-r1
router: route to pool=boston-fallback, attach route_origin=eu-bypass
sidecar: emit metering event req_id=abc123-r1 tokens=143 route_origin=eu-bypass
ingester: later sees orig event req_id=abc123 tokens=143 (from earlier path)
```
sam: the core problem: dedupe window + dedupe key composition. we need stable dedupe across retries.
rita: options: 1) teach edge to preserve an invariant dedupe_id header (X-dedupe-id) across retries, 2) change metering to coalesce by (orig_request_id OR parent_request_id) when available, 3) add route_origin into dedupe key so fallback doesn't change uniqueness.
alex: 3 is risky — route_origin might legitimately differ for retries and we could undercount real duplicates in other scenarios.
jia: 1 seems simplest and low-risk: edge sets X-dedupe-id := sha256(orig_request_id || client_ts) on first receive and keeps it on retries. then all downstream events share same dedupe id.
sam: agree, but requires edge rollout. maybe short-term hotfix on ingester: if event has orig_request_id_missing and we see two events within 2s with same tenant+payload fingerprint, suppress second. hacky.
rita: can we do a minimal change on router side NOW? router has orig_request_id when it handles a retry, it could set dedupe_id header before sidecar sees it. that's a single-service change and can be canaried quickly.
alex: can we add `dedupe_id` creation in router: `dedupe_id = orig_request_id || '-' || truncated(UUID)`? if orig missing use request_id. then sidecars and ingester will use dedupe_id.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for router v2.3.1 -> 10% traffic.
sam: code-level note for ingester if we do both: prefer dedupe_id header if present, fallback to current behavior. also extend dedupe TTL to 30s for retry scenarios.
jia: I've opened a tiny PR to router to inject dedupe_id when orig_request_id present. link: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pull/482
rita: rolling the router canary now. please watch billing-preview for increases or decreases.
billing-bot: will re-run invoice-preview for flagged tenants at +5m and +15m.
alex: long-term let's standardize: edge must generate and preserve X-dedupe-id. I'll add to RFC-2026 (request-tracking). also add a console alert for large preview deltas when canaries are active.
sam: action items:
- deploy router change (rita) — in progress
- monitor preview diffs (billing-bot + alex) — scheduled
- edge RFC and plan (alex) — track in backlog
- ingester TTL tweak fallback (sam) — optional hotfix PR if we see more dupes

rita: for immediate rollforward: if canary doesn't improve counts we can rollback router change.
jia: initial +5m check shows dupes dropped for tenant_482. will update after +15m.
billing-bot: invoice-preview run complete (+15m): tenant_482 delta -> 0.7% (was 2.1%), tenant_77 -> 1.2% (was 3.8%), tenant_190 -> 2.9% (was 5.6%).
alex: that's promising. leaving canary up and increasing to 30% in 10m.
sam: let's also add a dashboard card in Console: "canary routing dedupe impact" with preview-delta and dedupe-rate to help ops. I'll file the dashboard ticket.
rita: opening rollback window 30m from now.
jia: FYI I'll scan logs for any cases where dedupe_id mismatches still occur due to third-party proxies rewriting headers. if we find those, we may need edge-preserved header.
alex: thanks all, good triage. follow-up RFC and dashboard ticket numbers to be posted in thread when created.
